claim_boundary: This file specifies an audit protocol. It reports no proof-structural novelty result for CNG or any post-freeze candidate.

checks: freeze theorem statement and assumptions before novelty comparison
record hidden positivity, interiority, finite-dimensionality, measurability, and nonemptiness assumptions
reject weakened targets and stronger unreported assumptions

canonicalization.generated_and_helper_policy: Generated declarations and helper multiplicity may affect cost but cannot by themselves create a novelty claim; irreducible motif signatures and audited route replacements are required.

steps: charge each shared declaration once in a route union
keep type and value dependencies distinct
retain a reversible mapping to exact declarations

ablations: ZDD lexical, frequency-descending, frequency-ascending, and first-seen orders
with versus without the candidate abstraction

result.canonicalization: proof-structure-wl-v1, two rounds, declaration names excluded
result.warning: New structural proxy signatures are not proofs of semantic irreducibility.

retrospective_cases.comparison: base predictable/realized route versus later variance and sparsity extensions
route-specific half-Tsallis leaves before and after constrained quadratic abstractions
OFUL confidence/width routes before and after shared elliptical-potential infrastructure

questions: Can the residual motif be explained without declaration names?
Does the abstraction replace audited route-specific subgraphs?
Is the reversible mapping to exact Lean declarations understandable?
Would a domain expert distinguish target novelty from proof novelty?
Do ordering/canonicalization ablations change the conclusion?

cng_candidate.name: Curvature-Noise-Gap calculus
cng_candidate.current_evidence: A route-independent finite algebra layer is compiled after the frozen graph. A name-independent two-round structural proxy observes 9 new color signatures and 5 new direct-support signatures, but does not establish semantic irreducibility. All three frozen benchmark structural supports are unchanged, existing-to-CNG dependency edges are zero, and held-out OFUL contains zero CNG declarations; backward compression and transfer are not demonstrated, the full Pareto relation is not assessed, and structural discovery is not established.
must_not_count_as_evidence: renaming or restating a Tsallis-INF derivation
adding helper lemmas without irreducible motif residual
lowering one route cost while increasing the other declared Pareto dimensions without disclosure
evaluating only theorem families used to design CNG
falsifiable_upgrade_criteria: a target-faithful compiled CNG interface replaces multiple route-specific subgraphs
the declared library-aware cost vector improves with a reported Pareto relation
at least one frozen held-out theorem family has positive transfer or a blocked obligation is unlocked
the result survives canonicalization, compression, and ordering ablations
independent human review finds the abstraction interpretable and the target/proof novelty split accurate
cng_candidate.failure_condition: If route replacement, Pareto improvement, or held-out transfer is absent, retain CNG as proposed or classify the work as coverage extension/library consolidation rather than proof-structural discovery.

scope_exclusion: No Chapter 13-17 declaration, card, page, or active-frontier mutation is part of this audit.
